data.title: Sum of the First 22 Terms
data.problem: Find the sum of the first 22 terms of the AP: 8, 3, −2, …

steps.text: Identify the first term and the common difference

data.tip: $d$ is second term minus first ($3 - 8$), not the other way round.

narration: Here is the problem: find the sum of the first twenty-two terms of the AP eight, three, minus two, and so on. Can you tell which formula we need before I start? {{b1.1}} First, read the AP: a is eight, and d is three minus eight, which is minus five. n is twenty-two. {{b1.2}} We want a sum, so we use S n equals n by two into two a plus n minus one into d. {{b1.3}} Put the values in: eleven into sixteen plus twenty-one into minus five, which is eleven into minus eighty-nine. {{b2}} So S twenty-two is minus nine hundred seventy-nine. Careful — d is the second term minus the first, not the other way round.
narration_hinglish: Problem देखो: AP आठ, तीन, माइनस दो… के पहले बाईस terms का sum निकालना है। शुरू करने से पहले सोचो — कौन-सा formula लगेगा? {{b1.1}} सबसे पहले AP पढ़ते हैं: first term a है आठ, और common difference d है तीन माइनस आठ, यानी माइनस पाँच। n है बाईस। {{b1.2}} हमें sum चाहिए, तो formula लगेगा: S n बराबर n by two into two a प्लस n माइनस one into d। {{b1.3}} अब values रखो: eleven into सोलह प्लस इक्कीस into माइनस पाँच, यानी eleven into माइनस नवासी। {{b2}} तो S twenty-two बराबर है माइनस नौ सौ उन्यासी। ध्यान रहे — d हमेशा second term माइनस first term होता है, उल्टा नहीं।
